_comment: This app is server-backed (sessions, moderation queue, Gloo-gated verse matching all live behind /api on the real Node process), so the WebView points at the LIVE deployed origin below rather than bundling public/ as offline static assets -- bundling would serve a page whose fetch('/api/...') calls resolve against nothing. That is also exactly the shape App Store Guideline 4.2 scrutinizes ('a website in a wrapper'); what justifies the wrapper is real native capability layered on top -- see public/native.js for native push registration and native status bar/splash screen, both of which no-op on the ordinary web since window.Capacitor is simply absent there.
_serverUrlWarning: server.url below is the Railway DEMO hostname, for local iteration only. Before any real App Store or Play Store submission this MUST be changed to the app's actual production domain (ideally functioningfaith.app itself, with an apple-app-site-association file for universal links) -- a *.up.railway.app URL visible in the WebView is a branding mismatch against the published Terms/Privacy and a reviewer red flag. See NATIVE.md.
